summary: Executed requested backend regression suites (P0-P2 + auth playbook) and targeted frontend integration/responsive checks on public preview URL. Backend passed fully; frontend found one critical role-routing regression for admin_marketing login redirect.

ui_bugs.issue: admin_marketing successfully authenticates but is redirected to '/' (landing page) instead of admin dashboard

integration_issues.issue: Frontend roleHome() mapping omits admin_marketing, so post-login navigation does not enter /admin/*

action_items: Fix frontend roleHome mapping in /app/frontend/src/pages/auth/Login.jsx to include admin_marketing redirect to /admin/dashboard.
Re-run frontend login test with marketing1@rilismusik.com after fix to confirm admin dashboard landing.
Optional maintenance: migrate FastAPI deprecated on_event handlers to lifespan handlers (warning observed in auth playbook test).
critical_code_review_comments: Critical: roleHome() in Login.jsx includes super_admin/admin_release/admin_finance/admin_support/admin_content but excludes admin_marketing, breaking approved requirement 'role admin_marketing berfungsi'.
P0 auth safeguards validated: bcrypt $2b$ hash format, HttpOnly+Secure cookies, credentialed CORS with explicit origin, brute-force lockout after 5 failures, seed_admin password update idempotency.
PPR approval flow correctly creates one combined invoice (base+add-on), remains idempotent under parallel admin approve, and enforces line-item sum integrity.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all targeted checks passed except admin_marketing redirect)

seed_data_creation: No new manual seed script created in this iteration. Executed backend tests create temporary records and clean them in finally blocks/teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI responsive checks passed at 1920x800 and 390x844 for Login, Upload wizard (/label/releases/upload), Profile bank panel, Admin Users, Admin Payments, and CMS Documents (no horizontal overflow). Login password visibility toggle works. Nav order check confirms Upload Rilisan is above Rilisan. Remaining blocker is admin_marketing redirect bug only.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: login with marketing1@rilismusik.com / Marketing#2026 via /login. Auth succeeds but URL lands on '/'. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/pages/auth/Login.jsx roleHome() hardcodes admin role list and omits 'admin_marketing'. Mitigation: include admin_marketing in admin redirect array (or centralize admin role constant from backend/shared config) and retest login redirect. No API flow is MOCKED. Known external integration status: SMTP Hostinger 535 remains environment issue; app behavior is best-effort/idempotent as validated by monthly email tests.
